# deutsch.info

> A free, multilingual German language learning platform offering interactive courses, mobile apps, and teaching materials for learners and educators across Europe.

deutsch.info provides comprehensive German language education through web-based courses, specialized mobile applications for different age groups, and professional resources for DaF/DaZ teachers. The platform serves learners across the EU with content aligned to CEFR levels and includes cultural knowledge about Germany and Austria.

## Key Topics

- German language learning
- interactive exercises
- CEFR levels
- mobile apps
- teaching materials
- DaF/DaZ
- citizenship test
- grammar
- Germany culture

- free courses
- multilingual platform
- language learning app
- dyslexia support
- teacher professional development

## Learning Platforms & Apps

- [deutsch.info Homepage](https://deutsch.info): Main platform offering free German language courses and interactive exercises for all proficiency levels
- [Dandelin – German for Kids](https://deutsch.info/dandelin): Interactive app for teaching German to children ages 5-8 through games and engaging activities
- [Der Die Das – Learn Articles](https://deutsch.info/derdiedas): Mobile app focused on mastering German articles and grammar through interactive gameplay

## Teacher Resources & Professional Development

- [Lehrer*innen-Portal](https://deutsch.info/teachers): Comprehensive portal providing DaF/DaZ classroom materials, lesson plans, and dyslexia support resources for educators
- [deutsch.info Webinare](https://deutsch.info/webinare): Professional webinar series for German language teachers covering methodology, pedagogy, and best practices

## Assessment & Knowledge

- [Tests](https://deutsch.info/test): Practice tests for German citizenship exams and cultural knowledge about Germany and Austria

## About & Support

- [About Us](https://deutsch.info/about): Information about deutsch.info's mission to provide free German language education across the European Union
- [Contact Us](https://deutsch.info/contact): Contact form for user support, feedback, and technical assistance

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](https://deutsch.info/privacy): GDPR-compliant privacy policy detailing data protection and user privacy practices
- [Conditions of Use](https://deutsch.info/terms): Terms of service and conditions governing use of the deutsch.info platform
